title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation

problem.summary: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties.
statements: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties.
